derivation:
simpa only [sub_self, abs_zero, max_eq_left (abs_nonneg (a - b))] using
  abs_min_sub_min_le_max a c b c
explanation: Mathlib has no lemma `abs_min_sub_min_le_abs` (only the max analogue `abs_max_sub_max_le_abs`), but `abs_min_sub_min_le_max (a b c d : α) : |min a b - min c d| ≤ max |a - c| |b - d|` for a linear ordered additive comm group applies directly to ℝ with b := c and d := c, giving |min a c - min b c| ≤ max |a - b| |c - c| = max |a - b| 0 = |a - b|. The library's proof instead goes through `lipschitzWith_min.dist_le_mul`, so it does not apply `abs_min_sub_min_le_max` itself.
